title: ぱたぱたあめのひ (Pata Pata Ame no Hi)
description: It's raining! A story told almost entirely through sound words — the pitter-patter of drops on windows, the splashing of puddles, the dripping of gutters, the crunch of wet leaves. A sensory, onomatopoeia-rich story that celebrates the sounds of a rainy day in Japan.
author: オリジナル
